message: Last week, as the forecast for a winter storm rolled in, I took a few minutes to gather up the flashlights and check the batteries. Turns out, my kids thought it was a fun scavenger hunt, and we ended up having a mini dance party in the living room by flashlight. Small win: we were ready for the storm, and I discovered my two left feet have some moves after all. Anyone else had a little prep turn into unexpected fun?
